chooseAgentFirst: Choose an agent to select its model and effort.
commandUnavailable: This agent runs a command. Its harness does not expose a model or effort setting.
httpUnavailable: This agent calls an HTTP endpoint. The destination service chooses its model.
gatewayUnavailable: This gateway chooses its model remotely; Paperclip has no per-task model setting for it.
search: Search or paste a model ID
noModels: No models in the catalog. Use the agent default or enter an exact model ID.
loadError: Could not load models. Try again, use the agent default, or enter an exact model ID.
customOpenRouterHint: Custom IDs: openrouter/provider/model. Provider access is checked when the run starts.
customIdHint: Custom model IDs can be pasted here. Provider access is checked when the run starts.
